L13·N2104unmasked layer
The neuron fires on ordinary mid-sentence continuation tokens (function words, possessives, appositive nouns) inside grammatically flowing prose — e.g. "In **this** guide", "change **in** human judgment", "Denver **voters**", "Lederer**’s**", "on **Tuesday**" — while it is strongly suppressed at breaks in headline/title-style fragments (colons, dashes, capitalized title words), so it appears to track "this sentence is continuing smoothly" rather than any single semantic topic.

L13·N6186unmasked layer
This neuron fires on the main transitive verb (or its particle) right at the point where it takes its complement — e.g. "which **set** new standards", "will **bring** … to a close", "we **develop** sophisticated arguments", "they **owe** their fragrance", "met **with** limited success", "caught **up** in" — and is strongly *suppressed* on the near-synonymous benefit-introducing verbs "create / provide / providing / bring (hope)" in the same slot, so it appears to encode which verb fills this VP-head position rather than any topic.
